## Answers

**h01** — S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:17`) — re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs every 12 h (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`; skips entries still valid ≥4 days, `runner.go:88`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed `server/server.go:162`, immediate `RunOnce` at `server/server.go:163`, ticker loop goroutine `server/server.go:169` (called from `Start` at `server/server.go:129`).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (executes `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:156`); reached asynchronously via `PostAsync` → `asyncPostQueue` → 4 worker goroutines (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-56`, `184`).
Protection (two layers): dial-time SSRF guard `safeDialContext` + `isReservedIP` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-79`, `internal/webhook/validate.go:44` (blocks loopback/RFC-1918/link-local/IPv6 equivalents listed at `validate.go:13-22`, also defeats DNS rebinding); and config-time `webhook.ValidateURL` — `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`, called when webhooks are created/updated (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`). Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`), only set in tests.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`, `IdentityProviderUserInfo`). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20-27`), the only concrete protocol; dispatched at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121` on `storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2`.

**h04** — No. `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once outside its own declaration: `store/db/db.go:22`, inside the `NewDBDriver` switch (declaration at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`). Repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB` returns only those two lines; tests that build a driver directly use `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/demo_seed_test.go:24`, `store/deployment_config_test.go:416`).

**h05** — Explicit Go code, per driver; no database-level rule. Two deletes run inside the delete-user transaction: `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions the user authored) and `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos) — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380,400`, `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:380,400`, `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:417,437`; orchestrated by `deleteUserTargetsTx` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:92`). Evidence of no DB rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schemas is `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109` and peers).

**h06** — Handlers (all `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service.go:157`)
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_service.go:513`) → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memo_service.go:562`)
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service_comments.go:119`)
- also `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`) and `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`), both via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`

Convergence: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, whose workers call `Post`).

**h07**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`, registered `fileserver.go:124`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (checks `userCache` first) — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (concrete driver; sqlite by default) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (peers: `store/db/postgres/user.go:87`, `store/db/mysql/user.go:84`)
- back in the handler: `parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)` — `fileserver.go:737` — the image is a base64 data URI stored in the `user.avatar_url` column, then MIME-allowlisted (`fileserver.go:75,201`) and written with `c.Blob` (`fileserver.go:209`).

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — yes, invoked from production — `server/server.go:163` (and from its own ticker loop, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — no — dead code; repo-wide grep for `RunOnce` finds no caller (not even tests). Only the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**h09** — 8 declarations total; 6 in non-test code. All 6 non-test declarers are invoked from non-test code:
- `*apiv1.SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — caller `server/server.go:206`
- `*store.Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — caller `server/server.go:146`
- `*cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — caller `store/store.go:74-76` (three cache instances)
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`; `*postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`; `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — all reached through the `store.Driver` interface at `store/store.go:78`
- Test-only (not counted as invoked from server code): `MemoFilterTestContext.Close` and `AttachmentFilterTestContext.Close` — `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`

**h10** — `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ~28 call sites (all within `internal/filter/render.go`, the SQL placeholder/arg builder). Runner-up among exported symbols: `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go:40`) with ~28 call sites but only 7 in non-test code.

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` (`store/user.go`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store/`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss` (~71 references).
2nd: `store.Memo` (`store/memo.go`) — ~6 packages: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload` (~51 references).
(`store.Attachment` is third, 3 packages.)

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:33` (the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` ... RETURNING` statement). Determination: `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and the flag default `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122,130`) → `profile.Driver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:43`) → `db.NewDBDriver` switch selects `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:20`) → `store.New(driver, …)` stores it as the `store.Driver` interface (`store/store.go:37`) → `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go`, after UID validation). The postgres/mysql `CreateMemo` (`store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`) are the other candidates and are only reached with `--driver postgres|mysql`.

**h13** — Impl: the unexported `markdown.service` struct wrapping goldmark — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (methods e.g. `ExtractAll` at `:356`, `ExtractProperties`); it is the only implementation of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`).
Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (and `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` for tests).
Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` — and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`), and the bulk backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`, currently uncalled — see h08).
Extracted: deduplicated `#tags`; `Property.Title` (leading H1 text), `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block/span), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (unchecked task box) — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:371-407`. `@mentions` are extracted in the same pass but not persisted in the payload. Snippets for previews are generated separately via `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:84`).

**h15**
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read gate: archived-only-creator, non-public requires auth, private requires creator) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility narrowing of `FindMemo` (anonymous → PUBLIC; other-user listing → PUBLIC+PROTECTED; self → filter expression) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:217-227`
- `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` (attachment/media serving, incl. share-token fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-703`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Reaction gates: `UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:38` and `:83`
- Attachment service memo-visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451`
- `APIV1Service.SetMemoAttachments` path — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:222`
- RSS feeds restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Frontend SSR/metadata restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Mention/notification suppression for private memos — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67`; email/inbox notification visibility gating — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`, `server/notification/email.go:313-316`
- SSE broadcast filtering by memo visibility — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` / `sse_event_helpers.go` (events carry `Visibility`, e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:75`)

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the repo (no `redis` import, dependency, or config). Caching is a bespoke in-process map-based cache, `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` at `:76`, `New` at `:76`, background `cleanupLoop` at `:200`). Three instances are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:39-52`). So user entries expire after **10 minutes**, and are also invalidated explicitly on update/delete (`store/user.go:98,122,132`, `store/user_delete.go:39`).

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise. Repo-wide search for `ratelimit`/`RateLimiter`/`golang.org/x/time/rate` returns nothing. The only Echo middleware registered is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`), plus static/SPA middleware in the frontend router (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`). The only concurrency limits are `semaphore.NewWeighted(3)` for thumbnails and `NewWeighted(2)` for image processing (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60`), and a 256 MiB request-body cap (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:20`) — resource guards, not rate limits.

**r03** — Premise is wrong: no nightly database-cleanup job exists and no scheduler is running. `internal/scheduler` is a standalone cron package that is **never imported by production code** — the only importers are its own `example_test.go:10` and `integration_test.go:13`. The `"0 2 * * *"` "daily-cleanup" you may have seen is an illustrative snippet in the package doc comment (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:15-21`), not a registered job. The only real background work is the 12-hour S3 presign runner (see h01).

**r04** — Premise is wrong: there is no message broker at all — no NATS, RabbitMQ/AMQP, or Kafka in `go.mod` or any Go file, and no queue declaration. Webhook delivery is in-process: `PostAsync` pushes onto a buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-56`) that call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`). Overflow is dropped with a warning, not persisted (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:189-193`).

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server anywhere (no matches for `graphql` in Go sources or `go.mod`). The public API is Protobuf/gRPC-defined: service definitions live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `common.proto`), generated into `proto/gen/api/v1`, and exposed over HTTP via grpc-gateway plus Connect RPC handlers (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64-141`). Additional non-gRPC surfaces: the HTTP file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), and MCP (`server/router/mcp/service.go`).
